# Claude Code Changelog Calendar

> Claude Code release notes from Anthropic's official CHANGELOG, synced once a day at 07:17 UTC, in English and Chinese. Curated by @ Xiaoyu Gao: https://github.com/gaoxiaoyu1228/claude-code-changelog-calendar

This file is the guide for agents and scripts. Everything below is public JSON over HTTPS: no key, no sign-up.

## Check for new releases
1. Read [releases/index.json](https://gaoxiaoyu1228.github.io/claude-code-changelog-calendar/releases/index.json): the newest 30 versions, newest first. Each item has `version`, `date`, `published`, `url`, `counts` and `json`.
2. Keep the items that are newer than the last version you saw (the first time, take only the newest). For each, read its `json` URL, for example [releases/2.1.319.json](https://gaoxiaoyu1228.github.io/claude-code-changelog-calendar/releases/2.1.319.json).
3. Summarize `entries[]` by type and link to each version's `url`. Remember the newest `version` for next time.
4. Once a day is enough. Missed more than 30 versions? Use data/all.json.

## Data
- [releases/index.json](https://gaoxiaoyu1228.github.io/claude-code-changelog-calendar/releases/index.json): the newest 30 versions (no entries), `latest` = newest version number.
- `releases/<version>.json`: one version: `version`, `date`, `published`, `url`, `counts`, `entries[]` (`type`, `en`, `zh`). The URL never changes.
- [latest.json](https://gaoxiaoyu1228.github.io/claude-code-changelog-calendar/latest.json): the last 7 release days in one file. `latest` = newest version; `releases[]` = same shape as `releases/<version>.json`.
- [data/all.json](https://gaoxiaoyu1228.github.io/claude-code-changelog-calendar/data/all.json): full history. `entries[]` = one line each (`date`, `version`, `type`, `en`, `zh`); `published` = version → exact time; `focus[]` = monthly highlights.
- [feed.xml](https://gaoxiaoyu1228.github.io/claude-code-changelog-calendar/feed.xml) / [feed.zh.xml](https://gaoxiaoyu1228.github.io/claude-code-changelog-calendar/feed.zh.xml): RSS, one item per version, newest 30.
- [changelog.csv](https://gaoxiaoyu1228.github.io/claude-code-changelog-calendar/changelog.csv): same as all.json, as CSV.
- [latest.svg](https://gaoxiaoyu1228.github.io/claude-code-changelog-calendar/latest.svg) / [latest-detail.svg](https://gaoxiaoyu1228.github.io/claude-code-changelog-calendar/latest-detail.svg): image card of the newest version (summary / with every entry); `.zh.svg` for Chinese.

## Fields
- `type` is one of: new, improved, fixed, removed, other. Entries are grouped in that order.
- `date` is the UTC day of the npm publish time; `published` is the exact ISO time (UTC).
- `counts` lists only the types that have entries.
- `en` is the original text; `zh` is the Chinese translation.
- `url` opens the version on the calendar page.
- Field names are stable: new fields may be added, existing ones are not renamed or removed.

## Access
- CORS is open (`Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`).
- Responses carry `ETag` and `Last-Modified`; send `If-None-Match` or `If-Modified-Since` and an unchanged file returns 304.
